snippet.title: The Great Release | New Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Our game is finally out! Free to play on Steam NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4814340/The_Great_Release

You're in a work meeting that should have been an email. Worry not, there is one way out! You need to fart to intoxicate the room but without raising the awareness around you. Leverage the distractions, blame the dog and earn bonus points for longest unnoticed toots. Do you have it in you?

Please enjoy each fart equally. 💨

#indiegamedev #comedygaming  #TheGreatRelease #indiegames #steamgames
